script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Tides of Terra

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(JASPER, late 30s, hunches over the control board, muttering to himself.
He's a local radio host, wearing a headset, mic clipped on, eyes focused
on a monitor displaying a live audience chat window.)

JASPER
(INTO MIC)
Another late night for our beloved town of Evergreen, population: 825.
But hey, that's what makes it special, right? Small-town life.

(Suddenly, a new message appears in the chat window.)

JASPER
(INTO MIC, surprised)
Hold that thought. We have a new entry on our mysterious chat channel.

INT. EVERGREEN LIBRARY - DAY

(Two teenagers, LUCY, 16, and OLIVER, 17, huddled around a computer.
They exchange excited glances.)

LUCY
(whispering)
Did you see the chat? The radio host mentioned us again!

OLIVER
(nods)
Let's keep our message short and intriguing.

(They type a cryptic message and send it.)

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(Jasper, surprised, reads the message.)

JASPER
(INTO MIC, puzzled)
"The ancient whispers beckon. The water calls. We answer."

(The studio line goes dead, leaving Jasper bewildered.)

EXT. EVERGREEN PARK - DAY

(A crowd of locals gathers around a new installation - an enormous
statue of an alien being, surrounded by a pond. They marvel and take
photos.)

INT. SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

(PRINCIPAL BAYLOR, 50s, stands in front of an assembly of students.)

PRINCIPAL BAYLOR
(addressing students)
Students, this strange statue was discovered overnight. We're inviting experts to investigate. Stay focused on your studies.

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(Jasper is restless. The phone rings. He answers.)

JASPER
(into mic)
Hello?

DR. ARKADI
(voice over phone)
Hello, Jasper. It's Dr. Arkadi from the National Science Foundation. We've received your message and are on our way to Evergreen.

INT. EVERGREEN PARK - DAY

(Dr. Arkadi and a team of scientists arrive, examining the statue closely.)

LUCY (voice over)
(whispering to Oliver, off-screen)
What if they discover it's not real?

OLIVER (voice over)
(smiling)
Then our story will become even more intriguing.

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(Jasper narrates the investigation's progress, fueling the townspeople's excitement.)

INT. EVERGREEN TOWN HALL - NIGHT

(A public meeting is held to discuss the meaning of the strange statue and its impact on Evergreen.)

INT. EVERGREEN LIBRARY - NIGHT

(Lucy and Oliver meet in the library, their secret unfolds.)

OLIVER
(looking at Lucy, determined)
They're coming, aren't they?

LUCY
(nods)
The aliens. They've been coming for years, watching us, waiting.

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(Jasper closes the show, his voice filled with anticipation.)

JASPER
(into mic)
And so, Evergreen waits. Together, we'll embrace the unknown, and maybe, just maybe, make first contact. This is Jasper, signing off. Goodnight, everyone.

INT. EVERGREEN PARK - NIGHT

(The statue begins to glow, sending ripples through the water. The townspeople gasp in awe.)

INT. RADIO STUDIO - NIGHT

(Jasper's eyes widen as he witnesses the event live on the radio.)

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
